bio_summary: Co-founder and CEO of Spellbook, the AI copilot for contract drafting and review — Canada's fastest-growing AI company as of 2025, with 4,000 customers in 80 countries and a $350 million post-money valuation after a $50 million Series B led by Khosla Ventures. Before Spellbook, Stevenson studied computer engineering, co-founded a music-hardware startup (Mune), and worked as Director of Engineering at a network-monitoring company. He founded Spellbook in 2022 alongside lawyer Daniel Di Maria and designer Matt Mayers, positioning it as 'Cursor for contracts.' His public commentary tends toward market-structure and technology-adoption themes.
credibility_note: Operator-practitioner building in adjacent AI space (legal AI); commentary on prediction markets reflects an informed outsider perspective rather than direct participant expertise.
